current_episode.title: Veena Jetti on Scaling with Syndication, Smart Debt, and AI

guest.bio_context: Veena Jetti graduated with a degree in finance at age 20 and worked in corporate real estate at Tishman Speyer before leaving in 2012 to invest independently. She started with single-family homes in Dallas and transitioned to multifamily syndication after a conversation with securities attorney Nick McGrew about raising capital. To date, she has completed over $1 billion in multifamily transactions, primarily in Texas, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Arizona, focusing on Class B value-add assets.

pending_qa.q: What was Vive Funds' largest transaction in 2023 and why was it significant?
pending_qa.r: Vive Funds completed a $131.5 million acquisition in 2023 that crossed the $1 billion portfolio threshold for Veena Jetti. What made this deal special was that it was the largest all-woman-led transaction in the entire country for 2023, which Jetti emphasized as important for her legacy of proving that diversity is a strength in commercial real estate.

pending_qa.q: What is Veena Jetti's investment criteria regarding board diversity and decision-making representation?
pending_qa.r: Veena Jetti stated that when pitching deals as an angel investor with her husband, the first question she asks is to see the decision-making suite, board of advisors, and C-suite. If she does not see diversity represented, she does not invest regardless of potential returns, because having 100% of a board from 31% of the population statistically cannot include the best talent, and she only wants to work with the best.
